meta.title: Nubian Archives Registry

status_codes.V: confirmed from the holder or a scholarly source
status_codes.P: partly confirmed (existence confirmed; access or exact holdings not)

meta.note: A finding aid. It links and cites; it does not copy holdings. Check licences before reuse.

archives.name: AUC Social Research Center: Ethnographic Survey of Egyptian Nubia (1961-1964)
archives.holder: American University in Cairo, Social Research Center
archives.nubian_relevance: Survey of Nubian villages before relocation and of Nubians in Cairo and Alexandria; photographs by Abdelfattah Eid (1962-64); synthesis volume Nubian Encounters (AUC Press, 2010, eds. N. Hopkins and S. Mehanna).

archives.name: Fernea papers (1948-2015)
archives.holder: Dolph Briscoe Center for American History, University of Texas at Austin
archives.nubian_relevance: Papers of Robert and Elizabeth Fernea; Robert Fernea led the Balana study in Old Nubia. Check which boxes concern Nubia.
archives.rights: Finding aid states no use restrictions

archives.name: Nubian recordings in the Phonogrammarchiv
archives.holder: Phonogrammarchiv, Austrian Academy of Sciences, Vienna
archives.period: 1911; 20th century (dates to be confirmed from the catalogue)
archives.nubian_relevance: Recordings by Hermann Junker (1911, Kenzi: tales, songs, a text about henna) and recordings from historical Nubia by Anna Hohenwart-Gerlachstein (subject of a current project by Fayrouz Kaddal).
archives.rights: Depositor and archive terms; contact the archive

archives.name: UNESCO Archives: Nubia campaign material
archives.nubian_relevance: Digitised resources on the International Campaign to Save the Monuments of Nubia.
archives.notes: Locate the item-level catalogue on the UNESCO Archives platform before citing.

archives.name: UNESDOC: International Campaign to Save the Monuments of Nubia documents
archives.nubian_relevance: Campaign reports, for example the progress report of 8 March to 8 June 1960.

archives.name: UNESCO documentation centres: index cards (Egypt and Sudan)
archives.nubian_relevance: Index cards for monuments (Egypt) and archaeological sites (Sudan), analysed by W. Carruthers (2020).
archives.notes: Physical location and access not confirmed.

archives.name: International Campaign to Save the Monuments of Nubia: executive committee reports (1963-1982)
archives.holder: Princeton University Library, United Nations Collection
archives.nubian_relevance: Almost complete run of reports, UNESCO/NUBIA/1-22.

archives.name: Nubian Languages and Culture Project (ELAR)
archives.nubian_relevance: Digital repository for Nubian language and intangible heritage documentation (K. Rowan).
archives.access: online (free in principle; check per collection)
archives.notes: Confirm the exact collection title and access level on the ELAR site.

archives.name: Scandinavian Joint Expedition to Sudanese Nubia: archives and finds
archives.nubian_relevance: Salvage archaeology around Wadi Halfa during the UNESCO campaign.

archives.name: Re-excavating SJE-350/II
archives.holder: University of Copenhagen (TexMeroe); records (c) Gustavianum Museum
archives.nubian_relevance: Digitised 1960s excavation records of a Late Antique grave in Sudanese Nubia.

archives.name: Digital reconstruction of the SJE concession landscape (dataset snd0944)
archives.holder: Swedish National Data Service; Uppsala University
archives.nubian_relevance: GIS reconstruction of a landscape now submerged by Lake Nasser.
archives.rights: Check licence on the catalogue record

archives.name: Oriental Institute Archives: Breasted Egyptian Expedition photographs (1905-1907)
archives.holder: Institute for the Study of Ancient Cultures, University of Chicago
archives.nubian_relevance: About 1,200 negatives; catalogue Lost Nubia (OIMP 24) of 52 photographs.

archives.name: Oriental Institute Nubian Expedition (1960-1968)
archives.holder: Institute for the Study of Ancient Cultures, University of Chicago
archives.nubian_relevance: Eleven volumes of final reports; about 15,000 objects.

archives.name: Sudan Collection (Khartoum Collection)
archives.holder: University of Bergen Library, Special Collections
archives.nubian_relevance: Copies of Sudanese manuscripts and documents digitised into a repository (Tsakos, Paasche, K. M. Omar).

archives.name: Narrating Nubia
archives.nubian_relevance: Collaborative exhibition on displacement and oral memory.

archives.name: Digital Nubia
archives.nubian_relevance: Digital reconstruction of Nubian places with displaced communities.

archives.name: Nubian Chronicles
archives.nubian_relevance: Funded project led by Ahmed El Antably.

archives.name: Database of Medieval Nubian Texts
archives.nubian_relevance: Digital foundation for the study of medieval literate culture in Nubia.

archives.name: Sudan Virtual Museum
archives.nubian_relevance: Online heritage platform launched during the war.
